verdict.rationale: Docs clearly document multimodal input support: image understanding (grok-docs-7), document/attachment search (grok-docs-26), audio speech-to-text with multiple formats (grok-docs-37), and per-model capability flags showing 'text, image → text' modalities (grok-supp-model-page). This goes beyond honest text-only scoping to actually deliver image, document, and audio input handling via the API. missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer confirmation that these multimodal inputs work as documented (community evidence only covers coding/text quality, not multimodal input testing), and no single unified doc enumerating all accepted input modalities per model in one place.
